---
title: "Output, audit and transport contract"
---

## Cross-surface invariant

A capability has one output contract. Native UI may present only the useful subset, but ODK, protocols and other adapters project the same declared output semantics.

## Core result

Every capability should make the useful result obvious and stable. Output names are part of the contract and should not drift between surfaces.

## Audit / ALCOA fields

Where relevant, outputs should retain enough context to reconstruct what happened: timestamps, method/version, device/provider information, hashes, calibration or sampling details, and other method-specific provenance. These fields remain available even when the native surface hides them by default.

## Full JSON

`methodmesh_full_json` is the portable complete return used when a caller needs the canonical structured result/audit envelope. Example XLSForms should include it where audit metadata is expected.

## Hashes

Hashes must be computed over the final bytes or canonical content they are intended to identify. Do not hash a pre-transform artefact and then return different bytes under the same claim.

## Binary artefacts

Images, PDFs and other binary outputs returned to Android/ODK require proper content URIs, `ClipData` and read grants. XLSForms should bind them to actual attachment-compatible question types rather than pretending a URI is ordinary text.
